# goslop text fixture — optional load_extension plus pure uses of the loaded
# name; ImportError leaves the caller to raise InvalidSchema (niquests
# async_session.py:620 FP shape)
lang: python
file: async_session.py
---
def get_adapter(self, url):
    scheme = parse_scheme(url)
    try:
        extension = load_extension(scheme, implementation=None)
        for prefix, adapter in self.adapters.items():
            if scheme in extension.supported_schemes() and extension.scheme_to_http_scheme(scheme) == parse_scheme(prefix):
                return adapter
    except ImportError:
        pass
    raise InvalidSchema(f"No connection adapters were found for {url!r}")
